LESSON: ARABIC ALPHABET

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: QUR’AN
Topic 1.1: Arabic alphabet

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Arabic alphabet. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read arabic alphabet with vowels in readiness for reading the Qur’an
2. pronounce Arabic sounds in simple Arabic words
3. appreciate the importance of correct pronunciation of the four letter words for proper recitation of the Qur’an. pronounce them.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. read arabic alphabet with vowels in readiness for reading the Qur’an
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to read arabic alphabet with vowels in readiness for reading the Qur’an. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. pronounce Arabic sounds in simple Arabic words
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to pronounce Arabic sounds in simple Arabic words. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate the importance of correct pronunciation of the four letter words for proper recitation of the Qur’an. pronounce them.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of correct pronunciation of the four letter words for proper recitation of the Qur’an. pronounce them. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Arabic alphabet.
2. Explain Arabic alphabet to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Arabic alphabet.
4. Show that you can: read arabic alphabet with vowels in readiness for reading the Qur’an
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Arabic alphabet. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Arabic alphabet important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. read arabic alphabet with vowels in readiness for reading the Qur’an
2. pronounce Arabic sounds in simple Arabic words
3. appreciate the importance of correct pronunciation of the four letter words for proper recitation of the Qur’an. pronounce them.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
